For a frozen model/context, define eligible negatives E and exact target-outranking set H⊆E, using consistent tie handling. For sampled unique set S, observed coverage is C=|S∩H|/|H|; its sampling baseline is C₀=Σᵢ∈Hπᵢ/|H|. Report C alongside C₀ and C/C₀: low absolute coverage can be mechanically expected. With m independent replacement draws, πᵢ=1−(1−qᵢ)^m. Uniform sampling uses qᵢ=1/|E|; popularity sampling uses normalized weights over E. Uniform sampling without replacement gives πᵢ=m/|E|. Weighted sampling without replacement requires design-specific inclusion probabilities, not automatically mqᵢ. These follow standard [inclusion-probability formulas](https://online.stat.psu.edu/stat506/Lesson03); the coverage normalization is their direct application. Empty H makes coverage undefined.

For rejection sampling with proposal gᵢ and acceptance aᵢ, accepted draws have qᵢ=gᵢaᵢ/Σⱼgⱼaⱼ; rejecting seen items therefore renormalizes over eligible items. Distinguish m accepted draws from m proposals: with a fixed proposal budget, πᵢ=1−(1−gᵢaᵢ)^m. Rejecting duplicates until m unique items instead induces sampling without replacement. This follows [rejection-sampling conditioning](https://math.nyu.edu/~goodman/teaching/MonteCarlo12/notes/Week1.pdf). Repeat the exact diagnostic sampler independently, holding scores fixed; report coverage quantiles and Monte Carlo uncertainty. Inclusion events are dependent, so a binomial interval across items is generally inappropriate. Items with zero inclusion probability must be reported separately.

Fresh post-training sampling measures current sampler accessibility, not cumulative optimizer exposure. Log actual context–negative occurrences, unique coverage, and multiplicities during training. For independent draws with predetermined probabilities qᵢ,ₜ, cumulative inclusion is 1−∏ₜ(1−qᵢ,ₜ); adaptive sampling requires conditional analysis or logs. Historical exposure also does not establish that an item outranked the target when trained, received substantial gradients, or was adequately optimized.
